# So the transform order is: ROTATE then XOR
# Forward: input -> rotate -> XOR -> compare with target
# Reverse: target -> XOR -> reverse_rotate -> original input

def forward_rotation(data, length):
    """Just the rotation part from fcn.00002290"""
    data = bytearray(data)
    key = 0x23  # 35
    
    total_bits = length * 8
    remainder = key % total_bits
    r9 = remainder & 7
    r10_bytes = remainder >> 3 if remainder > 7 else 0
    r10_bits = 8 - r9
    
    # Byte rotation: rotate right by r10_bytes
    if r10_bytes > 0:
        data = bytearray(data[-r10_bytes:] + data[:-r10_bytes])
    
    # Bit rotation
    carry = (data[-1] << r10_bits) & 0xFF
    for i in range(length):
        old_byte = data[i]
        new_carry = (old_byte << r10_bits) & 0xFF
        shifted = old_byte >> r9
        data[i] = (carry | shifted) & 0xFF
        carry = new_carry
    
    return bytes(data)

def reverse_rotation(data, length):
    """Reverse the rotation"""
    data = bytearray(data)
    key = 0x23  # 35
    
    total_bits = length * 8
    remainder = key % total_bits
    r9 = remainder & 7
    r10_bytes = remainder >> 3 if remainder > 7 else 0
    r10_bits = 8 - r9
    
    # Reverse bit rotation
    result = bytearray(length)
    for i in range(length):
        next_idx = (i + 1) % length
        result[i] = ((data[i] << r9) | (data[next_idx] >> r10_bits)) & 0xFF
    
    data = result
    
    # Reverse byte rotation: rotate left by r10_bytes
    if r10_bytes > 0:
        data = bytearray(data[r10_bytes:] + data[:r10_bytes])
    
    return bytes(data)

    data = bytearray(input_str)

    data = bytearray(target)
